company.shortDescription: Lucky provides a fintech application that combines credit, cashback rewards, and payment-related services into one digital platform.
company.description:
Lucky provides a fintech application that combines consumer credit, cashback rewards, and payment-related services into a single digital platform. The company enables users to access short-term credit options, discounts, and vouchers that can be used both online and in physical retail environments, helping users manage spending and purchasing activities. Its platform integrates a marketplace of partner merchants, where users can shop through affiliated retailers and earn cashback rewards funded by commissions shared from those merchants. These rewards can be accumulated in a digital wallet and later redeemed for purchases or withdrawn, creating an incentive-based shopping and payment ecosystem.

Lucky also offers embedded financial tools that support flexible payment methods, allowing users to spread costs or access credit at the point of purchase. This functionality is designed to expand financial access, particularly for users who may have limited exposure to traditional banking or lending products.
